title: SEG Execution Coverage Record
description: Schema for an ExecutionCoverageRecord document in the Safety Evidence Graph. Represents Part 2 of the evidence package — proves that the test specifications declared in the design graph were actually executed against a specific implementation state, and records their outcomes. Independently verifiable against repo C (test runner records) and repo G (waiver records). Immutable once generated.

id.description: Globally unique IRI for this execution coverage record. Form: {namespaceBase}/proof/{snapshotId}/execution-coverage.

seg:testRunId.description: Identifier of the test run this record covers. Must match the seg:runId on all referenced TestOutcome nodes.

seg:repoBSha.description: Full git SHA of repo B at the time of the test run. 40 hex chars for SHA-1 repos, 64 for SHA-256 repos. All TestOutcome nodes referenced in seg:outcomes must carry this same SHA. At proof generation time this SHA is compared against current repo B HEAD; a mismatch marks the affected outcomes stale. An auditor independently recomputes implementation node hashes by rerunning the implementation extractor at this SHA and comparing them against the nodeManifest sealed in the DesignConsistencyProof — node hashes are not stored in the live node records in repo G.

seg:outcomes.description: List of test outcome entries for all in-scope test specifications. Every in-scope TestSpecification must have an entry here — absence of an entry is a coverage gap flagged in the CoverageReport.

seg:outcomeId.description: IRI reference to the TestOutcome node for this result.

seg:outcome.description: Test execution result. Copied from the referenced TestOutcome node for quick access without graph traversal.

seg:waiverId.description: IRI reference to the Waiver node excusing this outcome. Present only when outcome is FAIL, ERROR, or SKIPPED and a valid non-expired waiver exists.

seg:waiverExpiry.description: Expiry date of the waiver, copied from the Waiver node for quick staleness checking at Gate 3 without graph traversal. Present only when seg:waiverId is present.
